issue_a_gate_5_discrepancy.root_cause: Conflation between the empty-path qualified bare-apex ratio (681/682 = 99.8533%) and the authoritative bare-apex phishing denominator (4,254). 4,254 * (681/682) = 4,247.76 ~ 4,248. Authoritative V8 Champion bare-apex recall is 4,170 / 4,254 (98.025%).
issue_a_gate_5_discrepancy.resolution: Confirmed authoritative Gate 5 bare-apex phishing cohort N = 4,254, V8 Baseline Recall = 98.025% (4,170 TPs). Candidate B1 matches 0 additional URLs in this bare-apex set, maintaining exactly 4,170 / 4,254 (98.025%, PASS >= 98.000%).

issue_b_benign_denominator.root_cause: The figure 43,027 was derived by adding the entire 174 golden fixtures (27,353 + 500 + 174 + 15,000 = 43,027) instead of only the 88 benign golden fixtures (42,941 + 86 malicious = 43,027).
issue_b_benign_denominator.resolution: Corrected benign denominator is 42,941 total benign URLs (42,937 unique URLs, 42,643 unique hosts, 40,845 unique registrable domains). Net new false positives across all 42,941 benign URLs is exactly 0 (0.0000% FPR).

issue_c_benchmark_raw_vs_adjudicated.root_cause: Historical draft error in Phase 1C.2B-2A S2 preflight subtracted 116 FPs from both baseline (420 - 116 = 304) and Track A candidate (228 - 116 = 112). True V8 baseline on Benchmark v1.0 is 419 raw FPs (83.80%) and 420 adjudicated FPs (84.00%). Category breakdown: Bare Apex 200/200 (100%), Deep Repo 145/150 (96.67%), Search 75/150 (50.00%).
issue_c_benchmark_raw_vs_adjudicated.resolution: Definitively documented that V8 baseline benchmark FPR is 84.00% (420/500 adjudicated) and 83.80% (419/500 raw). The 304 figure is formally deprecated as a historical transcription slip.
